title: Wilma NDE 9952
content: I was visiting my son for his birthday. Right after a good meal with wine, I felt a bit full. So, I went to the bathroom. When I came back towards the kitchen, I noticed that a baseball game was playing on the TV. I went back to sit in the kitchen, where my son joined me. I was feeling really dizzy, probably from the indigestion caused by eating too much fatty food. I was sitting in the kitchen trying not to be sick, when I passed out. As an aside, so my experience makes sense. At the time, I had learned about reincarnation. I was not convinced of its truth yet, but if it was true - I really preferred this life to be the last incarnation. All of a sudden, I was in the baseball stadium. I was hovering between the receiver and the referee near the marble. I was trying to make a choice between which one of them I would be in my next lifetime. Then I realized who I was; in this lifetime. This experience reminded me of an old TV program, Quantum Leap. In the show, a scientist had found a way to leap into other people’s bodies for a while. This concept frightened me. I thought that I just died and was going straight into somebody else's life. This meant I would be staying in an earthly life for many more years to come. I didn’t want that! I said 'No, I was at my son's house.' I woke up right away and vomited. I was ok after that. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2021 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. I lost consciousness after particularly fatty meal. Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes Too short of an experience. I didn’t take a peek really. I was too eager to come back to myself. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. It was the same. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I came back in my body. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Not as vivid Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Not as vivid Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Frightened to have to jump in somebody’s else life like that. I don’t want to come back next time when I die. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Other or several faiths - Curious about spirituality Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Other or several faiths. Even more curious than before Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain. Still pondering on the experience Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain. I thought I was dead and did not agree with the idea of another life straight away without my permission Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? No changes in my life. I am not a believer, just curious about the universe at large and my purpose in it. This experience just got me even more curious. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Was I dying or was it just a random out of body experience ? Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Told my son straight away and other people when appropriate. I didn’t get much feedback from my son. I suppose he was too concerned about my passing out and that his dog didn’t want him to come near me at that time. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I read about it previously. That’s probably why I thought I was dead or dying What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I was sure of its reality while living it. I just regret to have panicked and didn’t take the opportunity to experience it in a fuller manner What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. Same as before. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Uncertain I don’t understand the meaning of your question Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? If it ever happens, like a 'walk-in' type, I’ll try to take better notice of the surroundings but I won’t accept it. They better not call me back if it is not to keep me there. gk60o09_nde

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: In a baseball stadium, hovering between the receiver and the referee near the marble (home plate).

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She did not want to "go straight into somebody else's life" and insisted, "No, I was at my son's house."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Lost consciousness after a particularly fatty meal (dizziness/indigestion); not considered life-threatening.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Other or several faiths; curious about spirituality (now even more curious).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience content involved perceived imminent "walk-in"/reincarnation scenario (choosing between being the receiver or referee in a next lifetime).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE content began directly in a baseball stadium without tunnel/light/beings/life review/boundary; immediate return after refusing.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived being in a baseball stadium and "trying to make a choice" about which person (receiver vs referee) she would be in her next lifetime; compared it to the TV show Quantum Leap and feared "going straight into somebody else's life."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "All of a sudden, I was in the baseball stadium." "I was hovering between the receiver and the referee near the marble." "I thought that I just died and was going straight into somebody else's life." "I said 'No, I was at my son's house.' I woke up right away and vomited."
